findings.title: Acceptance mapping still does not map the specification’s numbered criteria
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 5 requires mapping “each criterion 1–20 to its owning prompt (per specification §2–11)” with exactly one primary owner.
findings.trigger: The mapping is used to assign the specification §10 acceptance tests to executable prompt owners.
findings.consequence: Prompts receive ownership of different, invented requirements, leaving the actual acceptance tests without reliable traceability or accountable execution owners.
findings.evidence: `acceptance_criteria_mapping.v1.md` claims its titles come directly from specification §10, but Criterion 2 is mapped as “Execution plan completeness and decomposition” while specification §10 Criterion 2 is “CLI behavior”; Criterion 3 is mapped as packaging skeleton while the specification says “Root resolution”; and Criterion 20 is mapped as end-to-end verification while the specification says “Inventory reproducibility.” Criterion 1, “Installed imports,” is assigned to pre-refactor inventory prompt P00 rather than a prompt that verifies the installed post-refactor distribution.

observations: Prior P00A-B04 is resolved: P02S v4 now exists under the authorized `prompts/generated/` path, the manifest references that path, and v3 remains byte-for-byte identical to HEAD.
Prior P00A-B02 remains resolved: generated P02S v4 explicitly owns live structured-file transformations and defines parser-based, dry-run, fixture, and idempotence controls.

The relocated P02S v4 does not currently validate because its schema directive still uses the v3-relative path `../../../schemas/prompt.schema.v4.json`; from `prompts/generated/` that resolves under `plans_internal/schemas/`. Criterion 6’s explicit validator targets P00A, which validates successfully, so this was not elevated to a blocker finding.

The v7 checkpoint’s “FILES CREATED” section still names the obsolete root-level P02S v4 path, and it claims nine tests although the generated prompt contains eight test entries. Neither discrepancy independently defeats the stated blocker criteria.
reasoning: The history matches both verdicts I issued. Manifest and authorization repairs are effective: the manifest has 13 prompts, nonempty disjoint ownership with more than 20 units, v3 is restored, and the generated replacement is in an allowed directory. The acceptance map repair remains substantively incorrect because its numbered rows do not correspond to the authoritative specification criteria, directly defeating Criterion 5.
